panels.title: Rainfall
panels.description: Bars (left axis): rain per bar (1 h at short time ranges, wider on long ones), from increase() of the station's yearly total, which matches its daily totals. Line (right axis): peak rain rate in each plotted interval.

Battery voltage per sensor for Energizer Ultimate Lithium AA cells. The bar runs from 1.2 V per cell (empty) to 1.6 V per cell (full, as these sensors report fresh cells), so 1.2-1.6 V for 1xAA and 2.4-3.0 V for the 2xAA WS90. Lithium cells hold a nearly flat voltage for most of their life and then drop quickly, so the bar is a health indicator rather than a true percentage: yellow (below 1.4 V per cell) means order batteries, red (below 1.3 V per cell) means replace now.
